title: TelemetryRecord
description: Structured time-slice telemetry feature record for AI behavior recognition and scheduling

id.description: Unique UUID or incremental record identifier

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the sample window

duration_seconds.description: Duration of the aggregation time-slice in seconds

app_name.description: Executable or process name of foreground application (e.g. WINWORD.EXE, Chrome.exe)

window_title_sanitized.description: Scrubbed, non-sensitive window title containing document and subject cues

screen_area_pct.description: Percentage of primary screen area occupied by foreground window

is_fullscreen.description: Whether the foreground window is in exclusive fullscreen mode

keystrokes_per_min.description: Aggregate typing speed in keystrokes per minute (NO characters stored)

mouse_velocity_avg.description: Average mouse movement speed in pixels per second

clicks_count.description: Total mouse button presses during the slice

is_audio_playing.description: Whether any system audio session is actively outputting sound

is_audio_recording.description: Whether any microphone or input audio capture session is active

system_idle_seconds.description: Seconds elapsed since the last global user input event

domain_label.description: Layer 2: Subject, course, or project name (e.g. Specialist Mathematics, Physics)

confidence.description: Confidence score of the classification (0.0 to 1.0)
